# EverSafe Fire Protection

> Florida-licensed fire protection engineering practice based in Central Florida. Every deliverable is prepared or reviewed by a Florida-licensed Professional Engineer (PE). Serves MEP firms, architects, sprinkler and alarm contractors, general contractors, and building owners statewide. Contact: 386-837-4057, info@eversafe-fire.com.

## Services

EverSafe offers six core services. Each one includes the sub-services listed under it.

### 1. Fire Sprinkler System Design (NFPA 13)
- [Fire Sprinkler System Design](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/fire-sprinkler-system-design.html): Wet, dry, pre-action, and antifreeze systems. Hydraulic calculations, water supply analysis, delegated design, PE-stamped shop drawings.
- [High-Piled & Rack Storage Design](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/high-piled-storage-florida.html): Sprinkler design for warehouses and storage.

### 2. Fire Alarm & Detection Design (NFPA 72)
- [Fire Alarm & Detection Design](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/fire-alarm-system-design.html): Device layout, riser diagrams, battery and voltage-drop calculations, sequence of operations, sealed submittals.

### 3. Life Safety & Egress (NFPA 101, NFPA 101A)
- [Life Safety Plans](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/life-safety-plans-florida.html): Life safety sheets, egress and occupancy analysis, fire and smoke barrier plans, FSES worksheets.

### 4. Plan Review & PE Stamping
- [Plan Review & PE Stamping](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/pe-stamping-plan-review.html): Third-party review and PE sealing of contractor sprinkler and fire alarm drawings. AHJ comment response.

### 5. Code Consulting & Hazmat Compliance (FFPC, FBC, IFC Ch. 50)
- [Fire Code Consulting](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/fire-code-consulting-florida.html): Code analysis and alternative means and methods support.
- [HMIS Inventory Statements](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/hmis-inventory-statement-florida.html): Hazardous Materials Inventory Statements for hazmat permits.
- [MAQ Analysis](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/maq-analysis-florida.html): Maximum Allowable Quantity analysis per IFC Table 5003.1.1.

### 6. Special Hazards & Fire Modeling (NFPA 855, NFPA 2001)
- [Special Hazards Design](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/special-hazards-design-florida.html): Data centers, battery energy storage systems, clean agent suppression.
- [Fire & Smoke Modeling](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/fire-smoke-modeling-florida.html): Performance-based fire and smoke modeling.
- [Smoke Control Studies](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/smoke-studies-florida.html): Smoke control rational analysis.

## Articles & Guides

Short, plain-language guides answering common buyer questions about fire protection engineering in Florida.
- [Who Can Stamp Fire Sprinkler Drawings in Florida?](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/who-can-stamp-fire-sprinkler-drawings-florida.html): Only a Florida-licensed Professional Engineer (PE) can legally seal fire sprinkler drawings; explains when the stamp is required.
- [When Is a Fire Alarm Plan Review Required in Florida?](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/fire-alarm-plan-review-florida.html): Which fire alarm projects trigger plan review and sealed submittals.
- [What Does a Fire Protection Code Consultant Do?](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/fire-protection-code-consultant.html): When architects, MEP firms, and owners need code consulting support.
- [Life Safety Plan Requirements in Florida](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/life-safety-plan-requirements-florida.html): What a life safety plan covers and when one is required.
